ja: 『機動戦士ガンダム SEED DESTINY』よりラクスのハロがFigure-rise Mechanicsにラインアップ！
• 手足を引き出すギミックで、元気でかわいらしいハロを表現！手のひらにのる直径80mm。
• 瞳にはクリアパーツを使用し、別売りLEDユニットで光らせることができる！
• 目のパーツは可動式で、ノーマル、つり目、たれ目、と表情豊かにディスプレイ可能！
• 内部構造は一部新規造形にて再現。内部メカが見える状態でディスプレイできるクリア外装付属！
en: Lacus' Haro from "Mobile Suit Gundam SEED DESTINY" is now available in Figure-rise Mechanics!
• A gimmick that pulls out limbs to create a lively and cute halo! 80mm in diameter that fits in the palm of your hand.
• Clear parts are used for the eyes, which can be illuminated with an optional LED unit!
• The eye parts are movable and can be displayed in a variety of expressive ways, including normal, slanted, and drooping eyes!
• The internal structure is partially reproduced with new modeling. Comes with a clear exterior that allows you to display the internal mechanism clearly!
